question: Which country won the maximum number of medals at 2020 Summer Olympic Games (played in 2021)?
solution:
The correct answer is __**United States of America.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• The United States was represented by the** United States Olympic & Paralympic Committee (USOPC)** at the 2020 Summer Olympics in Tokyo.
 
• The country finished the Games with **113 medals**, the most amongst all nations: **39 gold, 41 silver, and 33 bronze.**
 
• US** **won the maximum number of medals at 2020 Summer Olympic Games (played in 2021)
 
• These individual totals were each the highest of the Games.
 
• This was the third consecutive Summer Olympics that the U.S. was the medal table leader. 
 
• The medal total was slightly lower than five years prior in Rio de Janeiro, where the United States won 46 gold and 121 total medals.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Here's how many medals each country has:
 
 
• **United States: 113 medals (39 gold, 41 silver, 33 bronze)**
 
• **China: 88 medals (38 gold, 32 silver, 18 bronze)**
 
• **ROC: 71 medals (20 gold, 28 silver, 23 bronze)**
 
• **Great Britain: 65 medals (22 gold, 21 silver, 22 bronze)**
 
• **Japan: 58 medals (27 gold, 14 silver, 17 bronze) **
